normalized/02_site-notes.md:
Site visit notes - Kometankuja 6, 26 March 2026
Written by Jukka Lahtinen, site manager

Weather: -1 C in the morning, fog. Snow on the roof, about 20 cm.

Roof
- The roof renovation is one week behind schedule because of the snow.
- The scaffolding on the north side has not been inspected yet. Inspection must be done before Friday.
- Three tiles on the south slope are cracked and need replacing.

Facade
- Demolition of the brick wall is under way. The frame is open on levels 2 and 3.
- Water damage was found behind the old cladding on the east wall, about 2 square metres.

Workers on site: 4 subcontractors and 1 own machine operator.

To do: book the scaffolding inspection, order replacement tiles, photograph the east wall damage.
